description: One wiki page's provenance, version 1, kept at .neo/<bookId>/pages/<chId>.json in the library: the Markdown file it was imported from, that file's SHA-256 when it came in, and its frontmatter as read. The page's words are the chapter's; NEO never shows the frontmatter.

path.description: The file as it was picked, an absolute path on the machine that imported it.

name.description: The page's title when it came in: the file's name without .md, or the name an import list gave it.

sections.description: For a page cut from part of the file (a split), the headings whose sections it holds, in order.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the whole file's bytes, in hex, a split's too.

frontmatter.description: The frontmatter as read, dates as written; null for a page with none.
